title: A comprehensive review on the capability of graphene quantum dots-based/involved platforms for the detection of inorganic ions
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,46079-46151
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04935K, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Prashant Dubey
Easily synthesizable GQDs/modified-GQDs or their integrated versions with other components can effectively probe various metal ions and anions via fluorimetric, colorimetric, electrochemical, chemiluminescence, and electrochemiluminescence methods.
